sections.title: Inputs And Frustum
sections.text: pupil required {origin, direction, up?}: optical pupil/datum; direction is the optical axis, up sets roll (horizontal axis). fov required {horizontal, vertical} full HFOV/VFOV angle expressions. ranges required {near, far} clip distances with 0 < near < far. window optional {distance, width, height} rectangular aperture centered on the axis; an edge smaller than the FOV cross-section limits the cone. schemaVersion required 1.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'optics.frustum',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,axis,horizontal,vertical,halfAngles:{horizontal,vertical},ranges:{near,far},corners:{near:[4],far:[4]},windowLimited,effectiveHalfAngles:{horizontal,vertical},clippedCorners}. windowLimited is true and effectiveHalfAngles shrink when a window edge limits the cone. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Window Edge Limits The Cone
examples.requires: Open Design document; a 60x40 deg FOV clipped by a 20x20 mm window at 50 mm.
examples.output: result.windowLimited is true and result.effectiveHalfAngles.horizontal is atan(0.2) approx 0.1974 rad.

sections.title: Inputs And Union Coverage
sections.text: sensors required nonempty array of {name?, pupil:{origin,direction,up?}, fov:{horizontal,vertical}, ranges:{near?,far?}}. targets required nonempty array of {name?, origin, normal, u, outline:[[x,y],...]}; outline is a polygon in the target plane (basis u, v = normal x u). samplingBudget optional positive integer default 100000. schemaVersion required 1. Coverage is the geometric union of frustum footprints over the target, never a sum of FOV angles.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'optics.coverage',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,targets:[{name,outlineArea,unionCoveredArea,sumIndividualArea,coveredFraction,deadZoneFraction,nearFieldGapFraction,farFieldGapFraction,sensorCount,samples}],samplingBudget}. unionCoveredArea accounts for overlap (union <= sum), and deadZoneFraction reports uncovered target. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Two Cameras Overlap (Union Below Sum)
examples.requires: Open Design document; two inward-tilted cameras covering one planar board.
examples.output: result.targets[0].unionCoveredArea is less than sumIndividualArea (overlap), and coveredFraction is below 1 where the cameras miss the corners.

sections.title: Inputs And Ray Casting
sections.text: pupil required {origin} ray origin. rays required nonempty array of {direction:[unit]} (infinite ray) or {target:[x,y,z]} (ray to a point). obstacles optional array of {name?, kind:opaque|baffle|window, shape:{type:box|disk|polygon,...}, transmittance?}; a window is transparent only when transmittance is provided or policy.transparentByDefault is true. policy optional {transparentByDefault?:false}. schemaVersion required 1. A render-transparent surface has no physical optical property unless declared.

examples.label: Baffle Blocks The IR Line
examples.requires: Open Design document; an IR source at the origin aimed at a lens 50 mm away with a 4 mm-radius baffle at 25 mm.
examples.output: result.rays[0].result is blocked with obstacleName baffle.

examples.label: Declared Window Passes The Ray
examples.requires: Open Design document; a declared transparent window with transmittance 0.9 at 25 mm.
examples.output: result.rays[0].result is window with transmittance 0.9 (not blocked).

sections.title: Inputs And Alignment
sections.text: sensor required {name?, origin, axis}. reference required {name?, origin, axis}: a reference axis (a magnet axis is a geometric axis, never a field claim). limits required {angle, offset, gap?:{min?,max?}}. forbiddenZones optional array of {name?, type:box, min, max}. schemaVersion required 1. Alignment checks angle deviation, lateral offset and axial gap against limits, and rejects a sensor axis entering a forbidden-material zone.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'sensor.alignment-check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,aligned,angleDeviation,angleDeviationDegrees,lateralOffset,axialGap,limits:{angle,offset,gap},violations:[...],forbiddenZoneIntersections:[...]}. status is pass when aligned (no violations), fail otherwise. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Sensor Axis Gap Exceeds Limit
examples.requires: Open Design document; a sensor axis tilted 5 degrees from the reference axis.
examples.output: result.angleDeviationDegrees is about 5, result.aligned is false and result.violations lists the angle deviation.

examples.label: Aligned Sensor Passes
examples.requires: Open Design document; a sensor axis exactly aligned with the reference.
examples.output: result.aligned is true, result.angleDeviation is 0 and result.violations is empty.
